title: Which audit findings need a clearer explanation before someone can fix them
body:
Run the fictional three-page example and read the resulting action list. Tell us where an explanation lacks evidence or an important limitation. Please share minimal synthetic HTML rather than a client's private export. [Tradesman SEO](https://tradesmanseo.co.uk/) maintains this project. Rule proposals should explain the observable input and a useful next action, without ranking guarantees.

Start with the [README](https://github.com/Tradesman-SEO/trades-site-audit-kit#readme), then run the documented example locally.
